conversionNotes: Raw MIT KEMAR Normal Pinna SOFA HRIRs with coordinates normalized to the SpaceTrace convention
releaseNote: SOFA remains the archival/source format. head.sthrtf is a derived SpaceTrace runtime representation; preserve the original source and license/provenance.

monoLevelCalibration.method: Front center 0/0 degrees at native head sample rate, including runtime fractional-delay magnitude and channel calibration gains; Dataset Corrected; Tone Trace Custom Max used the same deterministic pink-noise samples for reference and target; 80-16000 Hz pink-weighted level calibration; Stereo Pair and Papa Pan excluded.

currentStereoPairFiles.stereoPairCorrectionName: MIT KEMAR Normal Pinna Stereo Pair Tonal Restoration
currentStereoPairFiles.stereoPairCalibrationMethod: Centered Stereo Pair at 90/270 degrees, Width Offset 0; pink-weighted 80-16000 Hz binaural power including head level trim, ear gains, and the final convolved/faded correction WAVs; equal-and-opposite source gains; common pair trim matches independent unit-power stereo input. Normalization is applied by fixed gain metadata.

stereoPairPostCorrection.method: full linear convolution, retain original 8640-tap window, 40 ms half-cosine fade on retained tail; no WAV amplitude scaling
stereoPairPostCorrection.normalization: Fixed runtime Stereo Pair gain metadata, including head level trim; no WAV amplitude scaling
